# Vendor Questionnaire: VerifyCo Ltd

## 1. Vendor Profile
VerifyCo Ltd is a regulated identity verification provider headquartered in Vancouver. VerifyCo acts as the third-party provider for document verification, beneficial-owner lookups and sanctions screening.

## 2. Service Coverage
Data is processed in Canada and the United States. Sanctions screening covers OFAC, UN, EU and Canadian consolidated lists.

## 3. Compliance Program
VerifyCo has excellent AML controls and holds a SOC 2 Type II report. Sanctions list updates are applied within 24 hours. Screening thresholds are configurable per client.

## 4. Subcontractors
Document authenticity checks for non-Canadian passports are performed by a subcontracted specialist provider in the United States.

## 5. Volumes
VerifyCo can support up to 50,000 verifications per month for this program.
